notes.title: Demo Update 0.1514
notes.notes:
Demo version v0.1514

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enabled an additional goal for the Demo scenario - collect gold and reach the target tile.
[*] Added double-click functionality as an option for fast movement.
[*] Added new cards - [b]Trophy Bag[/b] and [b]Guiding Beam[/b].
[*] Added new ability - [b]Portal to the Town[/b] fast travel to town.
[*] Added [b]OR[/b] property to some cards - you can play them in one way or another.
[*] Added sound effects for some cards and opponents.
[*] Improved UI elements - window layouts and HUD icons.
[*] Added balance changes to cards and opponent difficulty.
[/list]


- cupuah

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1348
notes.notes:
Demo version v0.1348

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new battle cards.
[*] Updated card description - more clear naming for some cards (may/must discard card, for example).
[*] Pass on card description visualization and card images.
[*] Changed [b]Trophy Strike[/b] card.
[*] Fixed cauldron - now correct price for 6+ cards.
[*] Changed order while selecting cards from hand (now the same order as player hand).
[*] Changed displaying order for abilities in HUD (new always latest).
[*] Added [b]Sell All [/b]button in market.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1315
notes.notes:
Demo version v0.1315

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new dungeon encounters - [b]Cauldron [/b]and [b]Cursed Treasure[/b].
[*] Changed camp Curses Healer behaviour - now you can heal all wounds and curses at once.
[*] Added curses for ability deck.
[*] Balance update - changed cards drop probability and price for burning cards.
[*] Changed Copy card spell: now created cards have [b]Exile [/b]status.
[*] fixed behaviour for drawing card from discard (spell).
[*] Minor UI improvements.
[*] Minor music improvements.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback!

- cupuah

notes.title: Demo Update 0.0792
notes.notes:
Demo version v0.0792

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed descriptions for some cards.
[*] Added additional descriptions on the game field during tile selection for certain encounters.
[*] Updated the Discard window.
[*] Updated in-game stats calculation, including the number of visited tiles, encounters, and opponents.
[*] Updated card [b]Trophy Strike[/b] - now damage depends on the number of trophies in your deck.
[*] Added a new card - [b]Cursed Force[/b].
[*] Added new animation for [b]Exile [/b]cards - now the card disappears instead of flying into the deck.
[*]  Added additional sounds.
[*]  Balance changes for opponents, reward cards, and prices in the market.

Also, added additional improvements for the next big demo update - additional demo map.

[/list]
